cases.scope: Activity logging enabled/disabled and POSIX boolean versus void mutex initialization; fresh VM/P0 constructor, VM array/mutex and P0 transitions/stack ownership. Normal-cleanup control represents a proposed use of the existing VM destructor for constructor abort, not proof that current bootstrap reaches it; leak and ignored-mutex controls characterize existing cleanup/init boundaries. Double-cleanup is an injected bad repair. Assumes returning allocations/destructors and no concurrent log users. Excludes normal successful shutdown, auto-dump file I/O, repeated log start/stop, partial thread retirement, C pointer/ABI refinement and native admission.
